page: OVHcloud d2-8 is a KVM-based virtual server belonging to the Discovery family. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Haswell processor running at 2.0 GHz without TSX. The configuration includes 4 shared vCPUs, 4 physical cores, 8.0 GB of system memory providing 2.0 GB per core, and 50 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address and a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Benchmark results position this server in the lower tiers of performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU test scores 917.98, falling into the bottom 10%, while the multi-core CPU test reaches 3730.94, placing it in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show 322.39 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 35.67 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Cryptographic and physics processing are also limited, with a Passmark CPU encryption score of 949.1 and a physics score of 393.31, both in the bottom 10%.

Given the shared CPU allocation and modest benchmark scores, this server offers a budget-friendly hardware profile with a focus on resource density rather than raw compute power. It is suited for low-intensity workloads such as basic static web serving, which benchmarked at 2.96 GB/sec, lightweight Redis operations achieving 3.03 million operations per second, development environments, and non-critical testing scenarios where dedicated CPU availability is not required.
